tools.resnet: drone: ResNet-50 image classifier fine-tuned on all components; fast first check
tools.resnet_crops_mean: cloud: ResNet-50 on five overlapping crops and the full image, mean score
tools.resnet_crops_max: cloud: ResNet-50 on five overlapping crops and the full image, highest defect score
tools.resnet_recut: cloud: ResNet-50 on the component cut again from the full-resolution drone photo with context

tools.efficientnet: drone: EfficientNet-B0 image classifier fine-tuned on all components; small and fast
tools.dinov2_probe: cloud: DINOv2 self-supervised image features with a linear defect classifier
tools.yolo_cls: cloud: YOLO classification model fine-tuned on the six conditions
tools.quality: drone: Image quality check: blur and contrast; tells if the image is too poor to judge
tools.laya: cloud: laya-vision decision model, full precision; answers component, defect and condition
